summary: Crow's nest on Downey Peak, built in 1929 alongside Little Guard lookout; site labeled abandoned, with spikes still in a tree trunk.

facts.status_note: Site label reads Hike-In Abandoned; the only remains the site writers describe are spikes in a tree trunk.

access.note: Hike-in on Coeur d'Alene National Forest land per the site label; no closure or permit is described in the sources read. Medium confidence.

visit.trail_note: Hike-in per the site label. The site writers hiked about an hour up the peak and ridge; no named trail is described.

events.note: Site page: crow's nest established in conjunction with the Little Guard Lookout tower. The Little Guard history also gives 1929 for the crow's nest on Downey Peak.

notes_for_editor: The 1929 date is corroborated by two sites. The site description rests on one visit reported on idahofirelookouts.com; the writers assume the spikes mark the lookout position, which is their inference. The brief record had status unknown; the site label now gives abandoned, with no date. The sources give no date for the crow's nest being abandoned. A distance from Little Guard (about a mile) appeared in search snippets but was not verified in a cached page, so it is not used. Photo already in the idaho_fl source record; no new photo added. Little Guard is a Forest Service rental: fs.usda.gov reported a 2025 summer closure for restoration, which was not used in the story.
